hooks.description: Block local-patching of ~/.claude/plugins/cache and installed_plugins.json (set CANOPY_ALLOW_CACHE_PATCH=1 to override)
Block `git push` of a plugins/canopy/ change with no VERSION bump past origin/main — the #1 cause of red `Version sync check` CI (set CANOPY_ALLOW_PUSH_NO_BUMP=1 to override)

Block `gh pr merge` when another PR took your VERSION after CI went green — two commits sharing a version make the version-keyed plugin cache serve stale code (set CANOPY_ALLOW_MERGE_NO_BUMP=1 to override)
Keep the PRIMARY canopy checkout on `main` — block branch switch/create there (feature work goes in worktrees; the global CLI deploys from main). Set CANOPY_ALLOW_PRIMARY_BRANCH=1 to override
